messages:
sarah_support: NovaCapital POC is hitting intermittent 5xx (mostly 503) when ramping to ~300 rps during the demo window. Started ~09:10 UTC. Can someone triage?

mike_prod: On it. Can you paste a sample request + response body and the account id?

sarah_support: sample response: `HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable` 
`{"error":"capacity_throttled","retry_after":2}`
Account: `nova-poc-42`. We see autoscale activity in the console but spikes still cause 503s.

raj_sre: `capacity_throttled` usually means burstpool or GPU slot exhaustion on Hosted. Are they pinned to a large model?

sarah_support: They pinned to `gptx-70b-v1` for quality. This is a POC demo — customer insists on fidelity but we need reliability for their bench.

mike_prod: Two mitigation paths: (1) enable a temporary burstpool quota/rate override for the POC, (2) add a failover route to a lower-memory variant (13b) to avoid long warmups under pressure. Warmup + image pull can be ~30-60s.

sarah_support: Customer asks whether failover will change billing rates — quick answer for commercial?

liz_sales: Fallback billing uses the model rate of whichever model serves the request (13b rate if routed there). We can offer a small POC credit if needed. I can confirm with finance.

raj_sre: I pulled logs for `nova-poc-42` — queue depth spiked to ~120, concurrent_inflight peaked at ~80. Request ids: `req_abc123`, `req_def456`. Uploading debug bundle to the support bucket (link in ticket).

raj_sre: Proposed quick config change (applying now):
```
routing: {
  priority_policy: "latency_first",
  fallback_models: ["gptx-13b-v1"],
  max_concurrent_requests: 40
}
autoscale: { min_replicas: 2 }
burstpool_quota_override: true  # temporary, POC only
```

mike_prod: Note: `max_concurrent_requests: 40` prevents excessive inflight batching that causes OOM/backpressure. Also pre-warming an extra replica during the demo reduces warmup tail.

sarah_support: Can you also enable the temporary rate-limit override so the demo isn't throttled? They will run short-burst demos for the next 45m.

raj_sre: Done — bumped burstpool_quota for `nova-poc-42` and set `min_replicas=2`. Applied fallback to `gptx-13b-v1`. Monitoring now.

deploy-bot: autoscale event: added worker `host-rc-42` for nova-poc-42 at 2026-03-21T09:23:44Z

mike_prod: keep an eye on tail latency — if we still see 503s after these changes, we'll route a percentage (canary) to 13b first instead of full failover.

sarah_support: :thumbsup: I notified the customer and started the demo. So far ~12 minutes no 503s. Will report back if it resurfaces.

raj_sre: Observed errors drop immediately after changes. Leaving monitoring policy for 20m then we'll rollback burst override.

sarah_support: thanks all — marking as monitoring. I'll reopen if anything else crops up.
